claim: operand consumption at the axi_lite_dot boundary is bit-identical between the frozen and the optimised design; only the result push (w_en/data_w) moved by DOT_LAT cycles
method: combinational miter over the two r_en drivers, lifted verbatim from axi_lite_dot.v (frozen) and fp4_dot_stage.v (candidate), with the pipeline-occupancy vector vld left as a free input; solved with yosys sat / minisat

negative_control.mutation: dropped the `&& src` term from the candidate r_en drivers
negative_control.why: this is the most plausible way the restructure could have gone wrong: it would pop operands on drain cycles that carry none

latency_absorption.finding: the AXI read of the result is gated on the result FIFO's empty flag, not on any cycle count, so the DOT_LAT delay only makes s1_dr_valid assert later; nothing outside axi_lite_dot observes fp4 timing
latency_absorption.status: read from the RTL, not yet discharged formally
